How do you do? I am Gregory, the Gens Duprian Steward. What is your business with our gens?

How have you been? On behalf of the master of our clan, I thank you for answering the call of the clan. I personally hate to let the wandering mercenaries do this job, so I requested to send someone of the clan. I hope this didn't offend you. (Lv. 350 - 400)
How much is the registration fee and the deposit?
How will you help, exactly?
However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?
Hunt down 10 Spiders from around town, and I'll give you a reward.
Hunting down measly Spiders is beneath me. (Refuse)
Hunting down monsters....
Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.
I accept the mission. (Accept)
I accept your quest. (Accept)
I already knew that.
I already knew that. What's the next quest?
I am not ready yet. (Refuse)
I can almost see the end! (Accept)
I can't pass up on this. (Accept)
I didn't mean to pester you. But as the clan gets stronger, so do you. Please come back if you change your mind. (The quest has been cancelled.)
I don't feel like doing it. (Refuse)
I don't have the time right now. (Refuse)
I don't have the time right now. I'll do it next time.
I don't have the time. I'm sorry. (Refuse)
I don't have time right now. I'll come back later. (Refuse)
I don't know how this story can help me. (Refuse)
I don't need to be judged like this! (Refuse)
I don't think I have time for that right now. (Refuse)
I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.
I give up. Going any further is beyond me. (Refuse)
I got it!
I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?
I have a monster hunt quest that will take you deeper into the Dungeon than before. Will you accept this quest? (Level 101-110)
I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 131-180, Advanced character: Level 111-160)
I have a quest that will take you deep inside the Dungeon. It'll be harder than last time, but there's a better reward. Will you accept this quest? (Level 121-130)

I have a quest that will take you deep inside the Dungeon. There have been reports of monsters attempting to make their way above ground under the command of Gorgons. I want you to defeat these monsters. (Level 111-120)
I have a simple quest that will earn you a Scroll of Blood, which will grant you access to Illusion Temple. Will you accept? (All characters: Level 321-350)
I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 181-230, Advanced character: Level 161-210)
I have no time right now. (Refuse)
I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!
I hope you realize that a hero without a fighting spirit is merely a coward.
I know it well. I hear you need a special item to go there....
I know it well. I hear you need an item to participate in the event....
I learned a skill!
I need you to accept a small quest first as a test. Are you up to it? There is of course a reasonable reward for finishing.
I neither have the skills nor the warriors I need to take on this quest. Give me more time.
I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.
I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.
